summary: Iteration 36 — retest of iteration 35 fixes. All 4 fixes verified PASS + all regressions green. Backend 9/9 (7 prior + 2 new for Inter font). Frontend: (FIX1) .tglassnav is now sticky — top=0 after scrollTo(0,1500) with backdrop-filter blur(18px) saturate(1.5) and semi-transparent bg; still sticky at top=0 after switching pages via preview-page-* buttons (verified on Services page). (FIX2) 390px viewport: documentElement.scrollWidth === innerWidth === 390 (body.scrollWidth 390 as well) — no horizontal overflow; preview chrome scrolls away with content (nav still sticky at 0 while chrome scrolled off). (FIX3) 0 fetchpriority console warnings — only harmless 401 asset noise + a framer 'container non-static position' hint. (FIX4) PUT /api/apps/{id}/theme font_body='Inter' persists as 'Inter' (was previously rewritten to Manrope); v2 demo tenant app_5d6afc6e523f now correctly has font_heading='Sora' + font_body='Inter' with design_v2=true. Regressions: home hero .thero is 1080/1080=100svh full-height, but Services inner page has NO .thero-full class and hero is compact (~530px, left-aligned) as required; .fx-stagger classes present (5); .dsv2 root class present; page switching still animates. Old tenants app_7a2cd286a360 & app_e3cb4f084785 still have design_v2 unset. v2 export contains --t-h1, clamp(, backdrop-filter, sticky, .fx-stagger and lazy imgs; non-v2 export does NOT contain --t-h1.
critical_code_review_comments: Console emits a benign framer-motion warning 'Please ensure that the container has a non-static position, like relative/fixed/absolute to ensure scroll offset is calculated correctly.' — not user-visible but worth checking whether the scroll container in PublicPreview has position:relative for cleaner logs.
Two 401 asset requests observed on the public preview (likely font/analytics probes) — harmless but adds console noise; consider gating them behind auth-aware fetches.
